card.energyTip: Energy - depletes over time, restored by eating food tiles. At 0% the organism starves.
card.hydrationTip: Hydration - depletes over time, restored by drinking water. At 0% the organism dehydrates.
card.healthTip: Health - damaged by starvation, infection, and combat. Recovers slowly when needs are met.
card.infectionTip: Infection level - organism is sick and may spread illness to others nearby. Clears over time or near shelter.
card.infectedTip: Infected ({percent}%) - illness spreads through close contact with others
card.pregnantTip: Pregnant - a child will be born in ~3 in-world days
card.sexWordsTip: their words for the two kinds
card.attractionTip: This organism is drawn to another - they are building attraction and may bond

traitTip.curiosity: Curiosity - drives exploration and willingness to take risks
traitTip.aggression: Aggression - determines combat and territorial behaviour
traitTip.fear: Fear - how cautious the organism is around danger and predators
traitTip.memory: Memory - how many locations they can remember and how well
traitTip.social: Social - tendency to form bonds, trade, and travel with groups
traitTip.resilience: Resilience - resistance to disease, temperature stress, and starvation

status.traitTip: A trait they were born with, passed on from their parents
status.moodTip: How they feel right now, from what they are going through

tip.comfort: Comfort - rises near shelter and kin, falls in harsh conditions. High comfort boosts recovery.
tip.loneliness: Loneliness - builds when isolated, eased by social contact. High loneliness drives them to seek others.
tip.fear: Fear - spikes near predators and danger. Overrides normal behaviour; organism will flee.
tip.boredom: Boredom - rises when idle. Pushes the organism to explore, wander, or take risks.
tip.fatigue: Fatigue - builds without rest. Organism seeks shelter to sleep; high fatigue drains health.
tip.hope: Hope - rises when safe and well-fed, falls under threat or hunger.
tip.awe: Awe - deepens under open sky at night. Feeds spiritual growth.
tip.gratitude: Gratitude - accumulates in comfort surrounded by kin. Drives sharing.
tip.jealousy: Jealousy - creeps when rivals encroach during scarcity.
tip.anger: Anger - spikes against hostile neighbours, cools quickly when safe.
tip.regret: Regret - carried after outbursts or long grief.
tip.curiosity: Curiosity drive - bored, well-fed organisms wander further.
tip.spiritual: Spiritual depth - rises in safe nighttime shelter. Draws pilgrimages to temples.

tip.seeker: Drawn to knowledge — pursues exploration, science, and learning.
tip.wanderer: Restless and curious — happiest on the road, far from settlements.
tip.warrior: Born for conflict — gravitates toward combat and military life.
tip.connector: Lives for others — seeks partnerships, friendships, family.
tip.builder: Wants to make things — construction and craft are their calling.
tip.devout: A spiritual life — religion, ritual, and devotion guide them.
tip.sage: A teacher at heart — passes knowledge to the next generation.
tip.provider: Tends the household — agriculture, food, and family care.
tip.artist: Makes for the sake of making — paintings, song, written words.
tip.healer: Tends the sick — medicine, herbs, and the long patience of care.

skills.title: SKILLS
skills.tip: Grows with practice and by watching kin and friends who are better at it. A practised hand succeeds more often and gets more out of the same work.
skills.avoids: avoids {list} after being hurt at it
skills.lessonTip: Learned from a death: one they saw, one the elders told of, or caution carried from their parents. It fades over the years.

flavor.stone: steady, slow to anger, slow to fall
flavor.wolf: hunts in silence, trusts the pack
flavor.dawn: born of light, restless until day
flavor.hearth: keeps the fire, tends the home
flavor.seed: small now, but everything is coming

tip.curiosity: Curiosity - drives exploration and risk-taking. High curiosity organisms wander further and discover more.
tip.aggression: Aggression - determines combat initiation and territorial behaviour. High aggression = more challenges.
tip.fear: Fear - how quickly they flee danger. High fear means early retreat; low fear means standing ground.
tip.memory: Memory - how many locations they retain and how strongly. Better memory = smarter navigation.
tip.social: Social tendency - drives bonding, trading, and group travel. High social organisms form tribes faster.
tip.resilience: Resilience - resistance to disease, extreme temperatures, and starvation. Longer lifespan at high values.

life.foodTip: {count} food tile locations remembered - organism navigates toward these when hungry
life.waterTip: {count} water source locations remembered - organism navigates toward these when thirsty
life.dangerTip: {count} danger zones remembered - organism avoids these areas when possible

relations.title: RELATIONS
relations.allied: Allied with {name} - {percent}% positive attitude. Likely to trade and cooperate.
relations.hostile: Hostile toward {name} - {percent}% negative attitude. Likely to challenge or avoid.

bonds.title: PERSONAL BONDS
bonds.trusts: Trusts {name} - personal bond at {percent}%. Built through shared experiences and cooperation.
bonds.fears: Fears {name} - negative bond at {percent}%. Result of past conflict or aggression.
